_comment: Primitives governance allowlist — documented exceptions to scan-primitives rules.
_docs: Every entry requires: rule, file, line, pattern, reason, reviewer, expires.
_review_cadence: Quarterly. Remove entries that are no longer needed.

entries.reason: Test fixture inside a render() helper — renders a raw <button> to drive the signOut() hook under test. Converting to canonical Button would change the test component's rendering and could mask test regressions. Test fixtures are exempt from the primitive rule.
entries.why_safe: File is a __tests__ file never shipped to production. The button is rendered inside vitest/testing-library, not in the real UI.
